nodes.label: FRP connectivity relay deployment (*.relay.supermux.dev)
nodes.rationale: Production source of truth for the FRP-based relay, explicitly separate from the encrypted APNs/FCM push relay in src/relay/. Caddy is the only public edge (80/443) plus frps on 7000; the FRP HTTP vhost and control service bind loopback-only (8080, 7200) so only ports 22/80/443/7000 are publicly reachable.

nodes.label: Relay control service (Ed25519 proofs, HMAC leases)
nodes.rationale: Verifies Ed25519 host proofs, mints 24-hour HMAC leases, validates FRP Login/NewProxy hooks, and authorizes on-demand certificates only for verified hosts — so the host registry contains only identities that completed the proof.

nodes.label: frps soft systemd dependency on the control service
nodes.rationale: frps deliberately uses a soft dependency so restarting the control plane (e.g. after editing hosts.json) does not take the data-plane listener down and drop live tunnels.
